checkpoints.note: The witness enters the first `hb_shape(font, buffer, NULL, 0)` call on the fixed UTF-8 buffer. Both the crash stack and the MSan heap-origin stack belong to this call, not to the later UTF-32 shaping branch.

First non-harness project statement that consumes attacker-controlled input. It stores the fuzzer-supplied byte pointer into library state, which later backs all font-table reads through the face and font on the crashing path.

The loop is indexed by local `idx`, but the guard dereferences `buffer->cur()`, which uses the persistent buffer cursor instead of the loop index. Because GSUB left `buffer->idx == buffer->len` and `clear_positions()` did not reset it, the guard reads `info[len].mask` from uninitialized tail storage. The patch fixes this by reading `info[idx].mask`.
